snippet.title: Bounce Out - Atari ST / STE
snippet.description:
In this video, Bounce Out, released in 1988 for the Atari ST by Maynard International Ltd.
This is a fast video for a Pac Mania-like game with some modification. The graphics are simple, so it is the audio while playability is good like Pac Mania.
Here you'll find gameplay of the first level.

All footage taken from original hardware machines and upscaled to 1080P.

Let me know what do you think about the video in the comments below but, most important, Enjoy!!!
If you liked the video, please consider giving a thumb's up and maybe also subscribe. 

Thanks for watching.
